card.name: Punctuation right after the digit 3
card.fires_on: Punctuation such as a period, colon or hyphen that directly follows the digit 3, as in 3.0, Revelation 3:14 or ISBN 978-3-. It also appears after the 3 in phone numbers.

modes.label: Decimal after 3
modes.description: The period after a 3 that begins a decimal number such as 3.0.

modes.label: Verse colon after 3
modes.description: The colon after chapter 3 in a Bible reference.

modes.label: Hyphen in ISBN or DOI
modes.description: The hyphen after 3 within an ISBN or DOI code.

card.writes: It favors endings of ordinal and fraction words after 3, such as -thirds, nd, th and st, and suppresses 'rd'.
card.plain: It fires on the punctuation that comes right after a number 3, where the text is about to continue with digits.
